issues: Document is an accreditation scope for an INSPECTION BODY (орган инспекции, ГОСТ Р ИСО/МЭК 17020-2012), not a testing laboratory range table, so the source table has no numeric показатель/диапазон rows; range_from/range_to/unit are null on every row and tr_section is null throughout (no ТР ТС section-heading rows exist in this document -- ТР ТС references on rows 13-16 are ordinary document citations inside a documents cell, not headings, per the rule against substituting non-heading text). Source columns were: №, Наименование вида инспекции, Область инспекции (подобласть)/стадия инспекции, Код ОК, Код ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС, Документы устанавливающие требования к объектам инспекции, Документы устанавливающие методы инспекции. Mapped as: indicator = Наименование вида инспекции; object = Область инспекции (подобласть)/стадия инспекции (bold category heading + specific bullet item); norm_doc = the two document columns joined with '; ' (requirements doc then methods doc), null if both blank. okpd2_code/tnved_code were '-' for every row -> null. Rows numbered as ranges in the source (e.g. "1-6", "7-9"/"10-12", "13-14"/"15-16") were expanded into one JSON row per row number: group 1-6 = one row per bullet under one вид инспекции; groups 7-12 and 13-16 repeat the identical object/document content across two вид инспекции values (экспертиза / обследование) as printed -- this is not fabricated: bullet-count x type-count exactly matches the printed row-number range in both groups (3 bullets x 2 types = rows 7-12; 2 bullets x 2 types = rows 13-16), and no other content differs between the two Наименование values for those objects. Row 20 has no methods-document entry in the source (blank cell) and its norm_doc reflects only the requirements-document column. No rotated or illegible pages; all 6 pages read.
